knowledge_gaps: The repeated-support rule is underspecified: support threshold, recency decay, tokenization, vocabulary limits, auxiliary loss, temperature, and optimization schedule lack concrete definitions. Hard thresholding can prevent inactive contexts from learning through the semantic branch.

Positive cosine similarity between learned text vectors does not establish repeated interests. Common vocabulary or collapsed representations could activate support across unrelated items; missing-text masking alone does not prevent these shortcuts.

The residual scale lacks justification. Its magnitude is bounded by 0.5 and initially about 0.009, while SASRec logits have an unconstrained scale. The semantic branch could have negligible ranking influence. Its score can also favor redundant alternatives rather than address the reported redundancy problem.

Baseline, loss-only, and full-model trials cannot isolate the repeated-support mechanism. Include an otherwise identical ungated text residual and an auxiliary-loss ablation. Specify GPU-time allocations, checkpoint selection, and stopping rules within the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget.

Originality 6 and potential 8 are optimistic without direct comparisons to gated text fusion and interest pooling. Difficulty 5 may understate causal per-prefix pooling, multi-negative memory costs, and predictor/diagnostic parity. With only 200 validation users per category, repeated model selection also risks validation overfitting.

follow_up_queries.reason: Assess novelty and find safeguards against semantic shortcuts and inactive gates.
follow_up_queries.query: In text-enhanced sequential recommendation, what prior methods use repeated-history agreement or support-conditioned gated semantic residuals? What evidence addresses hard-threshold gradient starvation, common-token shortcuts, and representation collapse when item text encoders are trained from scratch without pretrained weights?

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine whether the proposed bounded branch can meaningfully affect rankings and identify a reproducible training objective.
follow_up_queries.query: For SASRec with dot-product item logits and sampled-softmax training, how do text-fusion methods calibrate a bounded cosine-similarity residual against collaborative score magnitudes? Compare learned scaling, temperature, normalization, gate initialization, and auxiliary text losses, especially without pretrained text embeddings.

follow_up_queries.reason: Strengthen causal attribution and quantify uncertainty without changing the pinned evaluator.
follow_up_queries.query: What evaluation practices address validation overfitting and uncertainty in sequential recommendation with sampled HR@10, 200 validation users per dataset, and 99 fixed negative candidates? Consider paired user-level bootstrap comparisons, repeated hyperparameter selection, and compute-matched ablations of loss-only, ungated text fusion, repeated-support gating, and auxiliary supervision.
